data.body: Fixed the last red Rust test (abaebe9): checkpoint_calling_an_unselected_capability_is_declined_without_ending_the_node. When context restore declines a recorded projection (a checkpoint calls a capability the acting pass does not select), the pass kept the turn's exchange cursor while carrying none of the recorded exchanges, so workspace/instruction context was positioned past the end of an empty exchange list and saving the replacement checkpoint failed with "Invalid model context: provider failed: provider tool request is invalid". restore_context now returns Carried/Declined and a declined pass re-bases the cursor on request.exchanges.len(), so the turn continues and the next turn re-imports the exchanges from committed records. Rust lib suite now 428 passed, 0 failed.
